meta.name: deeptools
meta.description: NGS analysis toolkit. BAM to bigWig conversion, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), heatmaps/profiles (TSS, peaks), for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将高通量测序数据转化为可视化分析图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在分析ChIP-seq、RNA-seq或ATAC-seq数据
copy.tagline_en: Transform high-throughput sequencing data into visualization and analysis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if analyzing ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, or ATAC-seq data

howto.what: 装上此技能后，Claude 会用 deepTools 命令行处理测序数据：把 BAM 转成 bigWig 覆盖度文件，做样品质控、相关性/PCA/指纹分析，并生成 TSS、peak 附近的 heatmap 和 profile 图，适用于 ChIP-seq、RNA-seq、ATAC-seq 等。
howto.when: 当用户要求 BAM 转 bigWig、质控/相关性分析、TSS 或 peak 热图等 NGS 分析时触发；也覆盖 RNA-seq、ATAC-seq 的覆盖度与可视化任务。

say.text: 对这几个 BAM 做质控：画相关性热图和 PCA 图。
把这些 bigWig 在 TSS 附近的信号做成矩阵并画 heatmap。

howto.what_en: Claude will use deepTools command-line tools to process NGS data: convert BAM to normalized bigWig coverage, run QC (fingerprint, correlation, PCA), and generate heatmaps/profiles around TSS or peaks for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask for BAM-to-bigWig conversion, quality control/correlation/PCA, TSS or peak heatmaps/profiles, or coverage/visualization tasks for RNA-seq and ATAC-seq.

say_en.text: Convert sample.bam to bigWig with bamCoverage, RPGC normalized, human hg38.
Run QC on these BAMs: draw a correlation heatmap and PCA plot.
Compute a signal matrix around TSS from these bigWigs and plot a heatmap.
